card.name: Inside words in all-caps label text
card.fires_on: Partway through long words, or on short linking words, in ALL-CAPS warning or heading text on drug labels. It responds to the all-caps style more than to any particular word.

modes.label: Split capitalized medical words
modes.description: Later pieces of long uppercase medical words that are split into parts.
modes.example: WARNING: ANAPHYLAXIS AND OTHER SERIOUS HY<<PER>>SENSITIVITY REACTIONS Serious hypers

modes.label: Small words in uppercase phrases
modes.description: Short words like of or and inside uppercase headings or lists.
modes.example: AMPHETAMINE SACCHARATE, AMPHETAMINE ASPARTATE, DEXTROAMPHETAMINE SULFATE<< AND>> AMPHETAMINE SULF

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of words in capital-letter warning headings on drug labels.
